flags.why: This title for an overseer belongs to older usage and is misleading as an unmarked modern job title ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/cai)).
The common meaning describing rain blowing into somewhere is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tạt)).
flags.fix: verb | to blow or drive against or into (of rain, wind, etc.); ex: Mưa tạt vào nhà. = Rain blew into the house.

flags.why: The everyday meaning 'dizzy; light-headed' is missing and is not conveyed by emotional shock or medical shock.
flags.fix: adj | dizzy; light-headed; ex: Đứng dậy đột ngột, tôi thấy choáng. = When I stood up suddenly, I felt dizzy.

flags.why: The example defines the word instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Bệnh nhân bị đau ở dương vật. = The patient has pain in his penis.

flags.why: Penguins inhabit the Antarctic region rather than the geographic South Pole, so the example does not illustrate the stated sense accurately.
flags.fix: Đoàn thám hiểm đã đến Nam Cực. = The expedition reached the South Pole.
